chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 155: Surrounded in the Gobi — Li Huowang Draws His Blade
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang’s paranoia forces a brutal retreat, but the Gobi night holds shadows with copper masks. Enemies close in from all sides. Trust is a memory.
og_title: Caught in the Open: Li Huowang’s Gobi Nightmare
og_description: An old monk, a copper mask, and shadow puppets that rise from the ground. Li Huowang’s escape is cut short as the desert becomes a killing ground.
twitter_title: Shadow Puppets and a Copper Mask in the Gobi
twitter_description: Li Huowang’s most paranoid instinct saves his group—only to lead them straight into a desert trap. The puppets are coming.
